meaning.en: Any of various forms of sexual acts regarded as perverted, especially anal intercourse, oral-anal contact, or sexual intercourse with an animal.

meaning.en: Any sexual intercourse held to be abnormal.  Bestiality. Anal intercourse, esp. between two male persons.
